acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Djinn family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Djinn, T3, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Ring-Vector Specialist (Specialist) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two fire construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Sharply defined figure with ornate sashes and jewelry, arms of visibly swirling wind, and gold rings orbiting the forearms.
Signature mechanic: Three-Wish Vector: three gold rings align around one visible wind forearm, then release pressure lanes in outer-to-inner order while the other arm stays still.
battlefieldDuty: Qualitatively pivot into a directional controller that separates visible wind-arm direction from orbiting-ring release order.
constructionDimensions: Material/structure branches: T1 vapor, half-face, and trailing plume gain an internal ceramic heat baffle; T2 the defined torso and plain cuffs gain an external fuel seam; T3 visible wind arms and orbiting rings gain ignition gaps; T4 crown and sacred script gain exhaust glyphs; T5 vortex, throne, and lamps gain bounded cooling tethers.

Motion/process branches use an engineered combustion process with tiered apparatus: T1 the vapor half-face draws fuel through a hidden plume baffle; T2 the torso exhausts through one cuff seam; T3 the wind arms ignite in orbiting-ring order; T4 crown script opens one exhaust glyph; T5 vortex, throne, and lamps feed and cool one tethered cycle.
counterplay: Move through the still arm's lane and strike the widest ring gap before the inner release. Affinity signal: Affinity counterplay branches: T1 the vapor half-face opens its plume-baffle apparatus after exhaust; T2 the torso cuff exposes its cooling fuel seam; T3 wind arms and orbiting rings expose the ignition gap after release; T4 crown script opens its exhaust glyph between clauses; T5 vortex, throne, and lamps expose the cooling tether after a combustion cycle.
forbiddenTreatments: Native warmth or smoke alone presented as Fire affinity
identityInvariants: A hovering humanoid upper body tapers into smoke instead of legs; solidity and scale change only at explicit tiers.
Sapphire or violet smoke, warm inner light, gold, brass, turquoise, silk, and gemstones remain distinct source materials.
Cuffs, rings, headpieces, lamps, and script mark proposed binding status without establishing universal culture or morality.
The body becomes less solid and more spatially dominant from half-face vapor to a palace-scale throne vortex.
telegraph: Ornate sash tails stream in one direction and the three forearm rings click into visibly unequal spacing.
